reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: comtechgold.com/proof-of-gold-audit and /faqs now serve SPA shells that redirect Digital Gold product traffic to cgold.ae; the prior TransGuard-named custody claim is no longer present in the live product bundle. The live cgold.ae content still states Digital Gold units are 100% backed by physical gold (standardized 999.9 purity bars), each unit represents 1 gram of 999.9 gold, bars are stored in UAE internationally accepted vaults with a secured and insured vaulting partner, and DMCC endorses gold stored in the vault. comtechgold.com meta still markets 100% gold-backed digital gold with secure UAE vaulting. No current bar-level composition or named custodian identity (TransGuard no longer stated). Modeled as one 100% allocated physical-gold slice without inventing a custodian name.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Live ComTech Gold product and FAQ disclosures of 1 gram of 999.9 physical gold per unit in UAE vaults
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The vaulting partner is not named on the live site; shares by bar, refiner, fineness grade within the 999.9 envelope, and a dated independent reserve examination report are not published.
